x1.description: input array or scalar. ``complex`` dtype are not supported.
constraints: must have same shape as x2 or broadcast compatible
x1 and x2 must either have same shape or broadcast compatible

x2.description: scalar or array. Specifies the return values when ``x1`` is ``0``. ``complex`` dtype are not supported. ``x1`` and ``x2`` must either have same shape or broadcast compatible.
constraints: must either have same shape as x1 or be a scalar
x2 must be one of 0, complex
x1 and x2 must either have same shape or broadcast compatible

output.description: An array containing the heaviside step function of ``x1``, promoting to inexact dtype.

constraints: x1 and x2 must either have same shape or broadcast compatible
